sweet-cream-diplomat.claim: Original recipe lists liquid whipping cream; the new source denotes that liquid cream before whipping, rather than the old explicitly fermented Smântână node.

sense_limits: Compas means the drawing instrument here, not a navigation compass.
Raportor means the angle-measuring instrument here, not a reporting person; raportoare is the neuter plural.
Taburet includes a primary seat and specialized piano-seat/footstool uses; the board uses the primary seating sense.
Mătură means the cleaning tool; accent-insensitive input also accepts the identical-looking verb form.
Cratiță is a distinct low-sided cooking vessel, not imported as an alias for Oală.
No hidden Contexto round is proposed for these new nodes.
Smântână remains the existing fermented sour-cream owner. The new qualified whipping cream never owns bare smântână, smântână dulce, or ready-whipped Frișcă.
Removing de8676 corrects the old false fermented-cream-to-Frișcă relation. The new cream→Frișcă link names its correct nonfermented source.

The redundant Echer→Riglă used_together reciprocal is omitted. Sweeps_into/collects_from and seat_for/played_from encode distinct directional roles already stated by their labels; they are not symmetric aliases.
